id./param/scenario/cs/b_170_cs_120.pack|cs_:
"I am the Timekeeper.
  I watch over the course of time.

"The Timekeeper...?
  Who are you, exactly?

"I am nothing at all.
  I merely watch
  the flow of time...

"...Timekeeper. We hear this tower holds
  a light with the power
  to restore what was lost.

"There is someone irreplaceable
  we wish to bring back...
  Please, tell us what you know.

"In the altar ahead is enshrined
  a jewel called
  Time's Sphere.

"Using the power of Time's Sphere,
  your wish may be granted.
  However...

"Do you truly have the resolve
  to seek lost time?
"Resolve...? What do you mean?

"Time's Sphere is the crystal of Erdrea's
  time, spun since ancient days by
  the spirits of lost time.

"By shattering it, the flow of time and space
  is disturbed, and all returns to the past.

"To revive your friend, you must
  sever the time of the world.

"To seek lost time... what you attempt
  is a great choice for the world.

"To bring Sister back, we'd have to
  turn back time for the whole world...

"The whole world, back to the past...
  Perhaps... no, but...
"If... if that's true...

"we could go back to before the Tree fell
  and stop Mordegon's evil ambition!

"Then it's not just Veronica...
  we might finally save everything
  Erdrea lost that day!!

"Perhaps... if you shatter the newest
  Sphere, the one spinning
  this very moment...

"you could return to just before
  the world was cloaked in darkness,
  as you wish.

"If I can return to the day that split the
  world's fate and stop Mordegon myself...
  I'll gladly go back!

"...Sadly, you cannot all
  go to the past.

"To break Time's Sphere requires
  great power that can sever all.

"Only one such power
  exists in this world.
"It is the Luminary's power that you hold.

"Your name is...
  Yes, {var:1}.

"{var:1}. With your Sword of Light,
  you should be able to
  shatter Time's Sphere.

"Only you can do it.
  Only you, {var:1}, can
  return to the past.

"Hold on. {var:1} will be able
  to come back here
  after going to the past, right?

"...Once you go to the past, you
  will likely never return to this world.
  And further...

"If the shattered Sphere runs wild,
  you may be swallowed by a
  twisted vortex of time.

"If swallowed by the vortex of time...
  {var:1} would wander the gap
  between times forever...
"No way...!

"Parting from your dear friends,
  returning to the past all alone.
  Even you cannot know what will happen.

"...{var:1}. Even so, do you have
  the resolve to return to the past
  and seek lost time?

"This choice is yours alone.
  When you are ready, go to the
  Altar of Time, where the Sphere waits...
